evals.prompt: I've been working as a technical writer at a SaaS company for 3 years, and I have three documents: my current resume (a bit outdated), a PDF of my latest Betterworks performance review from my manager, and an old CV from 2021. I need to create a modern, ATS-friendly resume that showcases my API documentation work and my GitHub portfolio. Can you generate both a Markdown and HTML version that I can host on GitHub?
evals.expected_output: Two files: resume.md (clean, ATS-optimized Markdown) and resume.html (modern, responsive HTML with portfolio section). The outputs should synthesize all three input documents, highlight quantified achievements from the Betterworks review, and include placeholders for GitHub portfolio links.
